title: Woman in Wallpapered Room
description: A woman in a long grey coat and blue scarf stands in a derelict room holding a vintage suitcase covered in stickers. She gazes up at a large wall covered in a repeating grid of identical painted portraits of a woman wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a patterned dress.
prompt: A woman wearing a long grey coat and blue scarf stands in a decaying tiled room holding a brown vintage suitcase covered in travel stickers. She looks up at a large wall covered in a 4x4 grid of identical stylized portraits of a mysterious woman with long dark hair, wearing a wide green hat and a dark patterned dress with a circular emblem. The wall is peeling and cracked with debris on the floor, under a glowing green and purple atmospheric sky.
